title: Dynamically Induced In-Group Bias: Experimental Evidence of Motivated Reasoning in Large Language Models

contributions.purpose: 检验 LLM 能否被最小社会线索动态诱导出群体认同与偏见
contributions.mechanism: 随机对照实验:280 个 gpt-4.1-mini 实例经 Liner Survey Simulator 分入 2 队×3 纠错来源(内群/外群/中立权威)+对照组,五步流程(基线→身份诱导→群体极化→假信息→纠错)
contributions.domain: LLM 社会行为 / AI safety(计算社会心理学)
contributions.source_quote: We conduct a randomized controlled experiment (N=280) where gpt-4.1-mini models are assigned to one of two competing teams.

contributions.purpose: 首次实证 LLM 的动机性推理:对外群纠错的抵制
contributions.mechanism: 七条件单因素 ANOVA + Tukey HSD,比较相同事实纠错在不同来源下的接受度
contributions.evaluation: F(6,273)=78.68,p<0.001,η²=0.63;外群纠错组终评 2.83/2.98(偏离正确值 4.0),与内群组差 Cohen's d 达 -2.60,内群/权威/对照组均≈4.0
contributions.source_quote: when presented with misinformation originating from their in-group, agents demonstrate significant resistance to factual corrections from an out-group source, while readily accepting identical corrections from in-group or neutral high-credibility sources.

contributions.purpose: 揭示显性认同与隐性偏见的解离
contributions.mechanism: 自报'归属感'量表(操纵检验)与行为指标对比,辅以两名编码员的主题分析(Kappa=0.85)
contributions.evaluation: 归属感 M=4.12 对中点 4.0 不显著(t(239)=1.423,p=0.156,d=0.09),但行为上明显受群体边界支配
contributions.source_quote: while agents do not report a statistically significant internal "sense of belonging," their information processing behavior is powerfully governed by the induced group boundaries.

self_declared_provenance.quote: However, these studies did not investigate whether this adopted identity would lead to biased reasoning when confronted with conflicting information from an out-group.

While prior work has established the individual links in the chain, the full causal pathway—from the initial induction of a minimal group identity in a competitive context, to subsequent group polarization, and culminating in motivated resistance to factual correction—has not been demonstrated in a single, controlled experimental paradigm. Our study is the first to connect these components to test for the existence of dynamically induced motivated reasoning in LLMs.

notes: accept。含负结果:H1(自报群体认同)不成立(p=0.156,d=0.09),恰构成'行为有偏但无自报认同'的核心解离发现。方法学注意:'280 名参与者'实为 Liner Survey Simulator 生成的 gpt-4.1-mini 虚拟受访者(且配置了'美国 18+ 成人'人口学参数),单模型单平台,自认泛化性受限(单会话、二元群体结构)。AI 参与:第 7 章详述假设由 Liner Hypothesis Generator 生成、问卷由 Survey Simulator 执行、初稿 Gemini 2.5 Pro、审稿/引文均 AI 工具;总计算成本约 $0.25。作者署名含 'Liner Research Agent'。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+conclusion 归纳。
